name: two_bodies_exported_by_force
why: THE WAY OUT EXISTS, AND IT IS DECLARED. One day somebody will be right -- two bodies that are to be printed together on purpose -- and a refusal with no way out gets bypassed by copying the file by hand, that is outside every check. With «export_anyway» the file is written AND THE ANSWER CARRIES IT WRITTEN that the check was overridden and what it said: whoever re-reads the report a month from now knows.
_why_twenty_four: two boxes, twelve triangles each. The number also says that the second body really ended up in the file: an STL that contained only one would have the same plausible size and would be the wrong part.

expect.why: the file written against the opinion of the check says so in the answer, and also says what was wrong

does_not_include: as geometry it can be exported
expect.why: the check said no and its sentence stays, whole: overriding it does not mean erasing it
